text: おばあちゃんの　おかお　いつも　おんせんに　はいっとるから　つるつる　だろ？

structure.jp: おばあちゃんの　おかお
いつも　おんせんに　はいっとるから
structure.en: because she's always in the hot spring

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is a dialect and old-person short form of ている, which shows something that is going on or done regularly. はいっとる = 'is (always) bathing in'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because'. The reason comes first, the result after. はいっとるから = 'because she bathes in it'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is a short form of だろう and asks the listener to agree: 'right?'. つるつる　だろ = 'it's smooth, isn't it?'
